behaviorHardened: External audit readback envelopes fail closed when a present teacherId does not match the signed teacher requested from external storage.
External audit records are normalized through backend teaching operation action definitions before readback responses are created.
Malformed external audit records that omit operation/action identity now fail closed with HTTP 502 and the message External teaching operation audit readback response is invalid.
Valid external audit records still pass and keep storagePolicy external-redacted-teaching-operation-append in the route response.
External audit events and domain projections are also normalized before course-ownership filtering.
